name: Copper/Gold Ratio ROC — SPY Long/Flat Strategy
description: Macro signal strategy that goes long SPY when the copper/gold ratio 60-day rate of change is positive (> 0%), and flat otherwise. The copper/gold ratio (HG/GC continuous futures, unadjusted) is used as a leading indicator for economic growth expectations. Position: 100% of equity in SPY when signal is active, 0% (flat) when signal is off.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio ROC — SPY Long/Flat Strategy
#
# Signal logic:
#   - Copper/Gold ratio = HG continuous close / GC continuous close (both NoAdjustment)
#   - 60-day ROC = (ratio / ratio_60_bars_ago) - 1
#   - Long SPY (100% equity) when 60d ROC > 10% (0.10 in decimal)
#   - Flat when 60d ROC <= 10%
#
# Both HG and GC use LiquidityBased rollover + NoAdjustment to preserve
# true price levels for ratio computation (avoids additive adjustment distortion).

# --- SPY Data (traded asset) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# --- HG (Copper) Reference Futures ---
# Using common_reference_futures directly (no continuation needed for a ratio signal —
# the ratio is used as a momentum/regime indicator, not for price-level analysis).
# keep_last resolution is acceptable here: both legs use the same resolution method,
# so any contract-selection noise cancels in the ratio.
hg_ref = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()

# --- GC (Gold) Reference Futures ---
gc_ref = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
# Ratio rises when copper outperforms gold → risk-on / growth signal
cu_au_ratio = hg_ref.c / gc_ref.c

# --- 60-Day Rate of Change on the Ratio ---
# roc outputs decimal fraction: 0.10 = 10% change
ratio_roc_60 = roc(period=60)(cu_au_ratio)

# --- Signal ---
# Long when 60d ROC > 10%, flat otherwise
long_signal = ratio_roc_60 > 0.0

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: no short_entry wired (strategy is long or flat, never short)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_signal)

# 100% of equity allocated when long, 0% when flat
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
